title: Ask vs Plan vs Agent (run)
summary: Ask is Q&A only. Plan shows a ToolPlan. Agent/run executes after confirmation.
narrative:
Ask is a read-only Q&A channel: LLMClient + KnowledgeBase. It does not generate executable plan steps, does not call skills, and does not call PlanExecutor.

Plan (default) turns natural language into a ToolPlan (JSON + plan.md) with side-effects labelled. Nothing high-side-effect runs until you confirm.

preview / plan --preview is dry-run Plan: you see steps, skills are not executed.

Agent is exposed as CLI/API run: generate plan then execute. Live-trade steps are never auto-executed; they stay plan-only.

If you want to list strategies, download data, backtest, or optimize, use Plan or preview — not Ask.
python_code:
from qteasy_ai.app import QteasyAssistant
assistant = QteasyAssistant()
ask_out = assistant.ask('explain PT vs PS')
plan_out = assistant.plan('list built-in strategies')
preview_out = assistant.preview('list built-in strategies')
risk_notes: Mode must be visible in every response so users can predict side effects.
